notes.title: Release 1.1
notes.notes:
New Gamemodes

Easy mode - A great way to get comfortable with the game.
Hard mode - Longer play with more of a challenge.
Long day and long night - Can you survive the long night?


Gameplay elements

Magical stone and tree farms provide resources without depleting.
New enemy - Slime
New enemy - Night terror


Bugfixes

Improved bow and arrow mechanics.
Wolfs no longer freeze when attacking cabins
Music now loops on longer nights
Towers can no longer attack Large Skulls
